summary.text: Christine Scianna is the Democratic candidate for the Arizona House of Representatives, District 29, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is an educator who advanced from the Democratic primary on July 21, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Scianna was born and raised in Phoenix, Arizona.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she holds a bachelor's degree in psychology, a post-bachelor's degree in education and a master of science degree in education.
She said that before working in education she worked in property management, including for John F. Long Properties.
Scianna said she has two adult daughters and two teenage stepchildren.
